nom: Bioderma Atoderm Shower Oil for very Dry to Atopic Skin

avis.titre: Best shower oil EVER! Just buy it lol
avis.texte: I've been using this product since the beginning of the year. It has completely changed my skin for the better. Changes didnt happen overnight, saw changes after a month of daily use. It's not super oily, no slipping in the shower. My skin is softer, smoother. My skin hasnt felt this smooth since I was in high school lol! I also use it on my face a couple nights a week. Game changer. The bottle also lasts quite a while. I shower twice a day. I'll be purchasing my third bottle soon.
Good product for the end of your shower. Leaves you silky with a light sent. I wish it was slightly thicker.
My family and I love this body wash. It's perfect for dry skin.

The only thing I use now for my very very dry skin. I wish I had know about it before now. My skin was dry itchy and nothing was working. One night I started googling what to use for extremely dry skin and this appeared. This has saved my skin!
Works well on my husbands dry and cracked hands. Worth the cost.
I have eczema and there was a recent bout of inflammation, skin dryness, flaky skin that this helped. My skin is much better after using this daily

Eversince i moved back home like 2 years ago my eczema has been a mess and flaring up real bad. Using the tiny perscitpion steriods wasnt doing it for my skin anymore so i tried this and omg litteraly i dont know how ive been livimg without this so far. Its help clear my skin, moisturize, and reduces my itchiness. My skin hasnt look this good in months!!!!! It does have a slight scent which isnt bad at all it smells like a natual smell and its not irrtating. If your eczema girly whose stuggling get this!! Do a patch test before of course but girl just buy it!!
I've been struggling to find a body wash that scores well (86/100 on Yuka) and actually makes my skin feel good. It lathers well and it is not super oily. My skin has been feeling amazing!

I really wanted to like it, but I have started to have breakouts on my legs, arms and chest when, historically, I've had clear but dry skin. I don't mind the scent and, honestly, like it. It emulsifies best with a wash cloth or loofah. It doesn't emulsify with just hands. I have normal to dry skin and slightly sensitive. It definitely helped me with my dry skin! Even my tattoo artist noticed how moisturized and hydrated my skin was during a leg tattoo. I paired it with the naturium bio lipid body lotion.

Most body washes make my skin slough off after I'm done showering (I've always assumed it's because they weren't moisturizing enough but perhaps it's an ingredient I'm sensitive to). This one not only doesn't do that, but it leaves my skin feeling super moisturized for about a day! It's even improved the mild keratosis pillaris on my arms. It does suds up, though not as readily as standard body washes. I am not a fan of the fragrance, but it goes away really quickly and isn't overpowering. Considering it's a body wash for people with atopic dermatitis, I'm surprised they didn't formulate it without fragrance. They should really consider removing the fragrance. Really I can't recommend it enough for people who suffer from dry skin and eczema or atopic dermatitis.

avis.titre: Covering the basics at a Bulk size
avis.texte: Lasts forever, emphasis on subtle for the scent and it is hydrating like it claims. Its not the fourain of youth but it does its job queitly and respectfully! I wouldnt say I have dry skin but its nice having an extra kick of hydration for the winter season. Its a shower OIL but i still get a lather with my exfoliation rag. I'd compare it to a baby body wash lather 🫧 Does great job removing waterproof makeup and sunscreen without striping skin (apply like cleansing oil first to loosen and then add water to suds it up and remove the makeup). IF YOU HAVE ACNE, youll want to keep an acne product on the side (like a benzoyl peroxide bar/wash). The wash is great for a clean slate but not really treating overgrowth of bacteria. FYI for people with severerly dry CRACKED skin (currently experiencing cracks on heel from autoimmune issue) id definitely recommend it. Theres a "patent" claim on it for creating a biofilm to prevent adhesion of certain bacteria like Staphylococcus Aureus. No stinging in cut either 👍🏼

texture and lather are nice. i dont like the fragrance. a product that is for extremley dry skin should be fragrance free or at least lower on the ingredient label due to risk of irritation and fragrance allergy. hate this as a face cleaner but its ok for the body.
I used this to wash my hands. It left them sticky after rinsing, and also kinda itchy. There's a notable perfume fragrance that I dislike.
My favorite body cleanser. Gentle yet effective. You could skip moisturizer if you wanted to
This is my shower cleanser and hand "soap". It is effective and it doesn't strip my skin.
anyone with severe eczema/a topic dermatitis can not use fragranced body products not sure why this is advertised to be a sensitive skin wash when there is fragrance listed as a added ingredient.

Recently I tried the L'occitane body oil wash and I didn't really like it. When I got it to lather it was nice but it was hard to work with. This one by Bioderma is really good as it lathers easier with less product needed and the size is great. The smell isn't super strong to me which I don't mind since I use products after my showers. Some say it has a more mature scent but I don't find it lingering for long out the shower. Overall I do think this is worth a try if you're prone to having dry skin or are a little lazy post shower. 9/10

Repurchased multiple times. This is a great first step to remove the film on my body from being out. I apply to basically dry sling and rub in and then turn on the shower and wash off. This feel great. Skin is not irritated by the fragrance, and I got used to it half way through my first bottle

avis.titre: Helps my dry skin caused from Lymphodema
avis.texte: I am not a doctor or anything like that but I can tell you this product is helpful in reducing the severely dry skin I have from Lymphodema. I have used this product for mo months now and it's helped my dry irritated skin feel much better.

I love this body wash and even use it as a cleanser for my face sometimes. It removes my makeup without my skin feeling tight. It's gentle and comes to a gantle foam. I saw you can even use it on babies! It doesn't leave me feeling greasy or the bottom of my tub oily. I started off with the smaller bottle and ended up buything the big one. It's a new shower staple for me!

I purchased this on the recommendation of a dermatologist that I follow on Instagram. She has been spot on with her product recommendations and this body oil wash has been one of them. I take 2 showers a day and this helps with keeping my body not only clean, but moisturized. As I'm aging, my skin is more dry and this helps to keep my skin moisturized.

Really intense old lady fragrance that thankfully doesn't hang around once washed off. Works effectively in hard water when combined with a silicone scrubbie. Great at removing make up gently. It does cause break outs on my upper back, likely because its harder to reach to emulsify with the scrubbie, so I use an alternate cleanser there.
This is a wonderful product and good for those with sensitive skin.

This is such a great body wash for dry skin. It's helped my dry skin stop itching and my skin truly feels moisturized. I highly recommend it especially if you have dry or sensitive skin! It does have a slight fragrance, but nothing too strong.

This is a nice product. It's most valuable as a makeup remover imo. Depending on what kind of water your home has, it may or may not gently lather. While it doesn't dry out your skin, it isn't doing anything to help with dry skin after bathing. I had success solving my dry skin area issues with AmLactin lotion.

avis.titre: Best Cleaning Oil in the Market
avis.texte: I follow an influencer dermatologist named Lindsey Zubritsky, MD. In one of her reals she said this was a good cleninsing oil for dry skin. I used another body cleanser that is not from Ulta named ceramedx. However, it didn't last in terms of hydration on my skin, still got itchiness from my eczema. I tried this cleansing oil and it is so moisturizing. It does have some fragrance, however it goes away after you get out of the shower. This is so hydrating that I even skip moisturizer when I get out of the shower. My itchiness is completely gone. If you get dry skin during cold weather, I highly recommend this cleanser.

I bought this on sale and knew nothing about it. I started using it as a makeup remover before I wash my face and I absolutely love it for that. just rub it on dry/ barely wet skin and rub your makeup away, rinse, then wash like normal. it helps remove everything without drying me out. I have combo skin and its not heavy at all!

I bought this on sale and knew nothing about it. I started using it as a makeup remover before I wash my face and I absolutely love it for that. just rub it on dry/ barely wet skin and rub your makeup away, rinse, then wash like normal. it helps remove everything without drying me out. I have combo skin and its not heavy at all!

I have used this for several months, and absolutely love it! It works great on my face and body no matter the weather. Hot, cold, humid, dry….it doesn't matter. This works for me in all conditions. Cleans well without leaving my skin dry. Cleans without making me feel like I swam in oil. It is such a multi-tasker too! Does a good job cleaning my face. I don't use shave cream on my legs anymore bc this is perfect for that too. I've become sensitive to fragrance, but this doesn't bother me at all. A little goes a long way. Another possible plus is that it seems to rinse nicely in my shower. I don't need to clean my shower as often since I started using this. I can definitely recommend it.

I have been suffering with irritated, dry, sensitive skin my whole life. For the last month I have been struggling with my skin and cerave wasn't touching it. I finally broke down and bought this. I had immediate relief and noticeable results in one use.
I was surprised that something marketed as being for dry and sensitive skin had such a strong floral scent. Its actually unbearble and I will be returning it.
